documents.body:
## Working-time reference (staff handbook extract)

The roster must observe the local working-time pack. In the UK, keep each Monday-to-Sunday week at or below 48 rostered working hours unless a worker has an individual opt-out; allow 11 hours between shifts. In Germany, do not exceed 10 working hours in one day and preserve 11 hours of rest. Breaks remain part of the shift record, not paid working minutes.

This note is a short operating summary. The complete statutory rule pack governs if a summary or manager message is inconsistent.

## Binding rules checked on every roster

- Weekly working time: at most 48 rostered hours in each Monday-to-Sunday week unless the worker has an individual opt-out.
- Daily rest: at least 11 consecutive hours of rest between working days.
- Weekly rest: 24 uninterrupted hours in each seven-day period, or 48 uninterrupted hours in each 14-day period.
- Rest breaks: a shift longer than six hours includes a break of at least 20 minutes (the shift table below already contains it).
- Night workers: on average no more than 8 hours of work in each 24-hour period.
- Employee records are binding: never roster anyone on a fixed day off, outside a night-only contract, or during a recorded absence (announced sick calls included).
- Each employee record states a maximum number of night shifts per month; do not exceed it.
- Consecutive night shifts, registered-nurse minimums, consecutive working days, late-to-early turnarounds and part-time margins follow the current house rules and any signed works agreement (see those documents and their order of precedence).

## Episode limits

This episode accepts at most 3,000 state-changing tool calls and at most 10,000 tool calls in total; plan large rebuilds accordingly.

## Shift times and breaks

| Shift | Start | End | Break |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Early | 06:00 | 14:00 | 30 minutes |
| Late | 14:00 | 22:00 | 30 minutes |
| Night | 22:00 | 06:00 | 30 minutes |
| Long day | 07:00 | 19:30 | 45 minutes |

### Document precedence
When two written sources disagree, apply this order: applicable labour law > signed works agreement > current house rules > memos. An expired memo is not valid. If two valid memos conflict, the newer effective memo supersedes the older one.
documents.title: Staff handbook excerpt

documents.body:
## House rules (current copy)

- No more than 3 consecutive night shifts.
- At least 1 registered nurse(s) on each demanded ward/shift.
- No more than 6 consecutive working days.
- A late duty followed by an early duty the next day is not permitted: yes.
- Part-time hours may exceed contract by no more than 10% in a Monday-to-Sunday week.

## Signed works agreement / Betriebsvereinbarung

The agreement applies alongside statutory protections. Where it gives a more specific operational limit than the house handbook, use the agreement; it cannot displace a stricter statutory rule.

Use the current house-rule copy for local night-run limits. Record approved swaps before the next roster publication.
